findings.summary: The language selector offers Arabic translations whose unresolved URLs become relative None links and return 404.
findings.fix: Restrict language-selector translations to public, routable pages and resolve each URL before rendering; omit unavailable translations or link explicitly to a valid locale landing page. Reuse the existing hreflangs URL-validation approach.
findings.evidence: 43 distinct crawled successful pages expose an Arabic link with href="None", across English, Icelandic, French and Portuguese. The crawl confirms /en/getting-started/overview/None/ returns 404.

findings.summary: The current-status reference link leads to a removed English URL and returns 404.
findings.fix: Update the CMS source and exported Markdown link to the current page-status reference location, and provide a redirect from /en/reference/page-status-definitions/ where practical.
findings.evidence: Production /en/how-to-guides/find-your-way-around/ links current status of the page to /en/reference/page-status-definitions/; the crawl records status 404 for that URL.

findings.summary: The French homepage Guides pratiques card leads to a missing French section and returns 404.
findings.fix: Publish the French how-to section or update the CMS card to a valid translated destination; suppress links to unavailable sections until a usable landing page exists.
findings.evidence: Production /fr/ exposes a Guides pratiques card linking to https://guide.wagtail.org/fr/how-to-guides/; the live crawl records HTTP 404 for that destination.

findings.summary: Feedback tooltips disappear when the pointer moves from their button onto the tooltip content.
findings.fix: Keep the tooltip visible while the pointer is over either its trigger or tooltip and provide Escape dismissal; consider visible helpful/not helpful labels that remove the need for explanatory hover content.
findings.evidence: Live Manage pages: hovering Happy displays This page was helpful. Moving the pointer into the tooltip rectangle (691,387;170×33) removes it within 500ms; Escape while hovering leaves it visible. Keyboard focus alone does not reveal it. See raw/tooltip-runtime.json.

passed: Crawled link inventory has no empty links without an aria-label, and no standalone click here/read more/learn more links.
All internal fragment targets referencing crawled pages resolve to recorded heading IDs; #main-content is handled by the skip-link audit.
Generated pilcrow section links are inside their corresponding heading and inherit programmatically determined heading context; ambiguous standalone names alone do not fail 2.4.4 AA.
Shared navigation, table-of-contents, section cards and article cross-links use descriptive destination names.
Content-copy controls correctly use buttons for copying and anchors for navigating to Markdown resources.
Markdown and llms text links describe the resource format in their visible names.
notes: Broken links are functional defects reported as n/a, not automatic WCAG 2.4.4 failures; their visible text still conveys intended purpose.
The None links are language-selector links, not image wrappers. apps/custom_media/image_formats.py only changes the fullwidth rendition filter.

Language names lack lang attributes despite hreflang on their destinations. Adding lang to each autonym can improve pronunciation; native language names may fall under the proper-name exception, so no unqualified 3.1.2 failure is asserted.
Shared Markdown-view links open new tabs without warning. Add a consistent visible/accessible new-tab cue as usability guidance; target=_blank alone does not establish an AA violation.
External destinations, private accounts and GitHub were not fetched.
Source and crawl inspection establish programmatic link context; native screen-reader link-list output was not tested.
Final completed crawl and successful-page link inventory reviewed: no unresolved internal heading fragments or standalone click here/read more/learn more/here links found.
French section link is an additional functional broken destination, separate from unresolved language-selector None URLs.

Supplemental feedback-tooltip behavior was explicitly requested with this link pass and is included here; it is a pointer-hover content failure under 1.4.13, independent of any missing Escape issue. No feedback request was sent during tooltip tests.

Happy/Unhappy accessible button names are interpretable with the preceding Was this page helpful question, but matching the explicit tooltip purpose (This page was helpful / This page could be improved) in visible labels and accessible names would reduce ambiguity. This is usability guidance, not a separately scored naming failure.
